messages:
jun: quick sync — thinking about the per-route console UX. Do we surface routing policy + quota hints directly in the route header, or tuck them into an 'advanced' flyout? Trying to weigh cognitive load vs discoverability.

sasha: +1 for badges in the header for 80% users. show critical bits (policy tier, quota state) inline. advanced flyout for full config. :thumbsup:

maria: agree on badges but we should make them interactive. clicking a badge opens a tiny panel with recent telemetry (errors, token burn). otherwise folks open >10 pages to debug.

jun: interactive badges make sense. what telemetry do we show by default? latency p50/p95, error rate, recent fallbacks?

david: keep it minimal: p50, p95, error rate, last rollout status. anything else can go in the detailed view. also suggest a small heatmap sparkline for token cost.

maria: +1 on rollout status — also show active fallback target (if any). Users get surprised when requests silently switch to smaller models.

jun: UX question: do we display routing policy rules in plain text or a compact DSL? e.g. 
```
if country == "EU" -> route: private-eu, fallback: dedicated-small
else if latency > 300ms -> route: hosted-lowcost
```
Would a compact DSL be clearer than a table?

sasha: compact DSL is neat for engineers but non-engineer PMs hate it. compromise: show human-readable summary line, with `view raw` to expand DSL.

essen-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout to console-feature/routing-ui v2 completed at 2026-02-13T09:12Z (meta: 24% traffic).

jun: thanks @ellen-bot — good timing. after the rollout we can A/B test badge prominence (inline vs collapsed). Need product telemetry for click/open rates.

david: small design ask: when route has quota approaching, badge should go amber and have an action: `Request burst` or link to quota docs. No more silent outages.

maria: idea: add a lightweight saved query quick-link: "show routes with quota < 20% and p95 > 1s" so SREs can triage. Saved queries should be sharable and show last-run timestamp.

jun: agree. let's capture action items:
- inline badges for policy tier + quota state (Sasha to prototype)
- interactive badge panel with p50/p95, error rate, token-sparkline (Maria + David)
- human summary + `view raw` for routing DSL (Jun to spec)
- saved-query quick-links for common triage filters (Product)
- A/B for collapsed vs inline badges after v2 rollout (PM + Analytics)

sasha: prototype ETA: next Wed. I'll drop mock in `#design` and ping here. :sparkles:

maria: will stub telemetry endpoints for badge panel this week. putting a note in the console telemetry ticket.

jun: nice — thanks all. follow-ups in thread or ping me for async reviews.
